name: InSubquery
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Name IN (SELECT v.Place FROM Views.Visit AS v)

name: NotInSubquery
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Name NOT IN (SELECT v.Place FROM Views.Visit AS v)

name: NotInNonNull
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Name NOT IN (SELECT v.Place FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Place IS NOT NULL)

name: InFiltered
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Name IN (SELECT v.Place FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Total > 3)

name: InEmpty
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Name IN (SELECT v.Place FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Total > 100)

name: NotInEmpty
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Name NOT IN (SELECT v.Place FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Total > 100)

name: InNumbers
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Rank IN (SELECT v.Total FROM Views.Visit AS v)

name: Exists
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT v.Place FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Place = l.Name)

name: NotExists
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT v.Place FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Place = l.Name)

name: ExistsSelf
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT o.Name FROM Views.Location AS o WHERE o.Rank > l.Rank)

name: ExistsUncorrelated
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT v.Place FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Total > 8)

name: ExistsAnd
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Rank = 3 AND EXISTS (SELECT v.Place FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Place = l.Name AND v.Total < 3)

name: ScalarAverage
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Amount > (SELECT AVG(o.Amount) FROM Views.Location AS o)

name: ScalarCorrelated
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Amount = (SELECT MAX(o.Amount) FROM Views.Location AS o WHERE o.Rank = l.Rank)

name: ScalarEmpty
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Rank = (SELECT MAX(v.Total) FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Total > 100)

name: ScalarCount
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Place = l.Name) AS Visits FROM Views.Location AS l

name: ScalarSum
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name, (SELECT SUM(v.Total) FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Place = l.Name) AS Visits FROM Views.Location AS l

name: ScalarLimit
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Rank = (SELECT o.Rank FROM Views.Location AS o WHERE o.Rank IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.Rank DESC LIMIT 1)

name: ScalarGrouped
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Rank = (SELECT MAX(o.Rank) FROM Views.Location AS o WHERE o.Region = 'North' GROUP BY o.Region)

name: NestedSubquery
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Name IN (SELECT v.Place FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Total > (SELECT MIN(w.Total) FROM Views.Visit AS w WHERE w.Place = l.Name))

name: HavingCorrelated
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT v.Place FROM Views.Visit AS v GROUP BY v.Place HAVING SUM(v.Total) > l.Rank)

name: ComputedCorrelated
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Rank = (SELECT v.Total - l.Rank FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Place = l.Name ORDER BY v.Total LIMIT 1)

name: ScalarNoRow
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Rank = (SELECT v.Total FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Total > 100 ORDER BY v.Total LIMIT 1) OR l.Rank = 1

name: Union
query: SELECT l.Name AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Rank = 1 UNION SELECT v.Place AS Name FROM Views.Visit AS v WHERE v.Total > 3

name: UnionDuplicates
query: SELECT l.Region AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l UNION SELECT l.Region AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l

name: UnionAll
query: SELECT l.Region AS Name FROM Views.Location AS l WHERE l.Rank > 1 UNION ALL SELECT v.Place AS Name FROM Views.Visit AS v

name: Chained
query: SELECT b.Name AS Name FROM Views.ViewBase AS b WHERE b.Rank > 1

name: ChainedJoin
query: SELECT b.Name AS Name, v.Total AS Visits FROM Views.ViewBase AS b INNER JOIN Views.Visit AS v ON v.Place = b.Name

name: ChainedGroup
query: SELECT b.Region AS Name, COUNT(*) AS Visits FROM Views.ViewBase AS b GROUP BY b.Region

name: ChainedTwice
query: SELECT c.Name AS Name FROM Views.ViewChainedBase AS c
